notes.title: Shut Up and Dance - New Chapter is Live on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey guys! [/h2][h3]We managed to finish the translation of the game into Chinese faster, so the update can be posted here sooner than planned! [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43424426/e147eded6bc0c8d1441109213d073e2f03546029.jpg"][/img]A few words about this update... It's been a bit more difficult than the previous one due to amount of animations and the number of huge lewd scenes, but nonetheless, it is here and hopefully you'll enjoy what's inside![/p][p]The lewd scenes this time depend hugely on your routes, so I really encourage you to check all of them. You can have fun with:
[b]- Sarah (Solo route)
- Open Sarah's extra scene (Backdoor *[i]WINK-WINK[/i])
- Megan and Sarah (Threesome route)
- Carrie (Special scene)
- Megan and Faith (Special scene)[/b][/p][p]So, what I'm trying to say here is that if you stick to one route only, you'll get quite a limited amount of content (if we drop out the main story), but in reality there's a lot more scenes to discover. I've also made a gallery indicator to highlight the scenes you might miss, hope it'll be helpful. Or you can always use Gallery Unlocker and see them all, heh. It's your call![/p][p]Alright, let's get started![/p][h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3][list][*][p]875 still images.[/p][/*][*][p]46 animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Edits in previous episodes.[/p][/*][*][p]Gallery indicator.[/p][/*][*][p]Code improvements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]CHINESE TRANSLATION (!!!).[/b]
You can switch the language in the settings menu. It's recommended to restart the game after the switch, especially if you use 3rd party mods for the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Polished a bit GUI and settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked some older animations (5 animations from the dinner scene with Megan in Episode 2 Ch.2)[/p][/*][/list][h3]That's it guys, have FUN![/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: Episode 10 Chapter 1 is Now Live on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43424426/a9275d1cc6674546a48b19e08b064a1c3515773f.png[/img]

Hey guys!

Another update is finally ready! It is quite different from the previous updates, so I'm really interested in your feedback about it. This time, apart from improving animations and visuals, I also payed a lot of attention to the narrative and overall story flow, which resulted in lots of different in-between renders as well as other not so obvious fixes here and there. I do believe that despite all of these work unconsciously, it still gives smoother narration and better experience.  Hopefully you'll enjoy everything!

And a few more words about the update. I think it's the first SUaD update which you can finish without seeing any sex scenes (Jeesh!), so just in case if this happens, here's a few hints about the scenes:

[list]
[*] It's better to be on the Love route with Megan and check the phone to see the whole scene.
[*] Dr. Wood's final scene opens only if you had sex with Megan in Episode 2.
[*] Sarah's special scene opens at the end of this update and it is available in her gallery.
[/list]

[b]What's been added:[/b]

[list]
[*] 1086 still images.
[*]  26 animations.
[*] Code improvements.
[*] Edits in previous episodes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43424426/3b4969f4b40783594abe9f754560535c405e2da0.jpg[/img]
